title: Native derived restriction along a proetale cover is jointly conservative
statement: Fix a prime $l$, a scheme $X$, and a family of weakly etale maps $g_i:W_i\to X$ covering in the proetale precoverage. For a morphism $\psi:K\to L$ of ordinary unbounded derived native adic sheaves on $X$ [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], if exact derived pullback of $\psi$ along every $g_i$ is invertible, then $\psi$ is invertible.

source.place: Constructibility and the isomorphism: restriction to affine charts and comparison of the specified exchange maps

proof.text: Apply the ordinary derived cohomology criterion. Exact native pullback commutes with every homology functor, so each homology map becomes invertible on the cover. Forget the native module action and identify weakly etale inverse image with localization restriction. The sheaf gluing axiom makes a map which is invertible on the covering family invertible globally. Reflect invertibility through the module forgetful functor, degree by degree. This is exactly the existing proof in the attached source declaration.
